Agents prism, umber and island cannot all claim one physical copy if each encoding is key-bound and too slow to reconstruct on demand. A thousand identities then require about 10 TB of persistent storage plus query bandwidth. This prices identity expansion in hardware, assuming replication proofs prevent shared-copy shortcuts.
